about: stagewright COURTYARD, as built by models/courtyard/build.py --out DIR (pass DIR as --root). Static scene facts only: Z-up, meters, default prim /World, the display time-code rate, and the west hall, east hall and north gallery footprints declared in the model's source/common.py inside the expansion geometry, up to the lower eave. The roof mechanism's opening condition is measured from recorded solver poses by the model's own tools; this audit does not check it.
